limitations: The approval pages were not driven in a browser. The vote calls used the route and body that the released frontend's decideApproval helper sends: execute-plans 86a4314b src/lib/bff-v1/writes.ts:1158-1180 posts {decision, memo, stageName, expected_version} to paths.approvalDecide(id) (paths.ts:88, /approvals/{id}/decide) and reuses the attempt's Idempotency-Key on retry; stageName was omitted here, as it is for whole-request votes. This comparison is a coordinator reading of that source, not an executed frontend test. The proposal and readback calls are coordinator calls, not frontend calls. Frontend rendering of pending versus final, its 409 refresh and its handling of a failed readback are not verified by this hosted run.

Capital reads of the fixture through the BFF were unavailable on this release (probe output: GET /bff/capital-pools/{id} 404 and binding list unavailable; tracked as BFF-CAPITAL-OWNER-READS-20261003); the Governance approval owner exercised here does not depend on them.
